main_text.p: XXXIV. dicta huc revocanda sunt. Propalatio occultorum scanda-lum parit. Illud vero, ceu Ecclesiæ noxium, vitari, quantum fieri poteft, debet, adhibitis gradibus, quos Christus ipse Matth.XVIII.15. &c. præscripsit. Eodem faciunt argumenta, quibus delationis officium à Pastore supra removimus.

Consentien-bus consti-tutionibus Ecclesiasticis Brandenburgicis; & civilibus patriis.XLIII. Providè igitur Serenissimi Electoris Brandenburgici Friderici Wilhelmi, Seculi nostri Herculis, Constitutiones Ecclesiasticæ Marcanæ & Clivenses, sic § 136. sanciunt: Die jenige betreffend/ welche in lehr oder leben irren / und unrichtig wandlen / deren sünde und fehler doch noch zur zeit verborgen wären/sollen die Prediger auch verborgen seyn lassen/ihnen aber ihre sünden vorhalten/und davon abzustehen sie fleissig in aller stille vermahnen; hoc est, Quantum ad il-los, qui in doctrina vel vita errant, & inordinate ambulant, quorum peccata ta-men & errores occulti adhuc sunt, eorum (peccata & errores) Pastores Ecclesiæ in occulto latere sinant, ita tamen, ut eadem peccata illis exprobrent, & eosdem, ut iis abstineant, diligenter magnoque cum silentio admoneant. Cui Sanctioni conformis est Ampl. Magistratus nostri lex Consistorialis vicesima secunda, qua Pastori Ecclesiæ potestas conceditur, peccatores sibi singulariter notos vel indicatos seorsim accersendi, & eosdem salutari admonitione corrigendi (durch die Oberfeitliche Still stands-ordnung sol einem Pfarzer nicht benommen seyn / die jenige/ so ihm sonderbar bekannt sind / oder gemacht worden / sonderbar zu-beschicken /und mit heilsamem zusprechen zuverbesserẽ.) Estque hæc, nisi fallor Ecclesiarum Protestantium constans & perpetua praxis, adeò ut ne Gallicanæ quidem Ecclesiæ,cùm imperio heterodoxo & tyrannico adhuc obnoxiæ fuissent, ad occulta ejusmodi, quatenus statum publicum non feriebant,reseranda obstrictæ fuerint.

Objectio, quòd delatione delinquentium ad Magistratum non prævia vel subsequente, peccata populi & Magistratu publicè grassantiaXLIV. Sed fortè Pastor Ecclesiæ officii sui in corripiendis pro suggestu etiam peccatoribus & scandalis, tum à populo, tum à Magistratu ipso manantibus, palàm pulsandis & corrigendis partes obire non poterit, nisi scandalorum illorum authores σημειῶν notare, & ad Magistratum etiam deferre velit & possit. Hoc scilicet illud est,quod à Pastoribus exigere quandóque audent illi, qui correptio-nis impatientes, ægrè ferunt, imò ringuntur, cùm in publica scan-dala,perjuria inprimis,dorophagiam,nefarias artes, capitalem inju-stitiam,aliáque ejusmodi palam & impunè grassantia, Ecclesiæ Mi-nistri pro suggestu detonant. page.notes: Black letter marks the German passages. The line-end hyphens in the margin note and in the Latin are printed hyphens and are kept. The text is cut off after "Still"; the rest of the sentence is in part 2. Top lines are the end of a paragraph begun on the previous page. Doubtful readings: "ἁγονδεάλας" (Greek word, marked [?]); the Greek after "authores" is read as σημειῶν. "zuverbesserẽ" has a tilde-like mark over the final e, copied as printed. The printed line ends "nitio-" continues on the next page. Left margin note text is small italic and was joined into one note; its hyphenated line breaks were resolved (e.g. "Magi-stratum", "pu-blicè").
